concept.reason: Original primary holotype photos and scale plus anatomical diagnosis suffice, no extra concept imagery.

classification: Sphenisciformes, stem penguin outside crown Spheniscidae
scope: Complete giant penguin with hyperelongate spear bill, narrow head, robust neck and powerful flippers. Subsequent pool, not frozen72.

scale.height_status: 2007 conservative minimum estimate via comparison of humeral dimensions to other giant penguins, not measured articulated skeleton.
scale.calibration_status: Rounded modeling estimates from Fig2 20mm scale, NOT direct published caliper values or Table1 transcription.
scale.preserved_parts: MUSM897 skull, axis+eight other cervicals, partial coracoids/scapula, left humerus/forearm/hand. Hindquarters and feet unpreserved in this holotype.

diagnostic_targets: Extremely long narrow straight spear-like bill taking more than two-thirds of skull length; not stubby emperor-penguin bill.
Narrow cranial region with strong neck beneath it; do not inflate head into spherical cartoon.
Two powerful flattened flippers with robust proximal structure and tapered tips, no flying feather fingers.
Complete streamlined upright penguin body, short tail and short webbed feet as explicit comparative reconstruction.
Muted darkgray/brown dorsum and lighter ventrum as uncertain palette, no invented proven colored throat/crest.
No teeth, horns, crests or modern species-specific yellow/orange head patches.
uncertainties: Holotype lacks hindlimbs/pelvis and bulk trunk; these are comparative penguin reconstruction, not species-specific fossil measurement.
Standing height1.5m is inferred, same for soft volume and external flipper contour.
Skull/humerus modeling dimensions are image-ruler approximations, not verified2008 measurement table.
2008 source full text was inaccessible; do not invent Table1 values.
Keratin sheath and plumage color unpreserved. Do not copy Inkayacu feather pigmentation onto Icadyptes.
acceptance: Whole penguin preserved with diagnostic long spear bill and powerful flippers.
Measured anatomical ratios distinguished from ruler-derived dimensions and body estimates.
Four exactGLB views and two reproducible builds, then independentQA.
